subject: ⏰ Enrolment Deposit Reminder — Due $deposit_due
body:
Dear $applicant_name,

This is a friendly reminder that your enrolment deposit is still outstanding. Paying it secures your place on the programme; missing the deadline may release your offer to a waiting candidate.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DEPOSIT SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Application ID:   $application_id
Programme:        $program_applied
Intake:           $semester $academic_year
Amount Due:       £$deposit_amount
Due Date:         $deposit_due
Days Remaining:   $days_remaining

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW TO PAY

  • Log in to the applicant portal and choose 'Pay Enrolment Deposit'.
  • Card, bank transfer, and international payment options are supported.
  • A receipt is emailed automatically once payment clears.

If you have already paid in the last 48 hours, please ignore this reminder — payments can take a short time to reconcile.

Need more time, or have a question about funding? Contact admissions@university.edu and we will be happy to help.

Kind regards,
University Admissions Office
